headline: Stlican Shelf, Weathered Expanse Lead Renewed Strongpoint Battles
war_summary: Since the last edition the line has flared once more. Weathered Expanse, quiet through the afternoon, recorded nine strategic-base changes in the latest two hours and twenty-seven in the day; the region now stands four Warden strongpoints to five Colonial, with the last change at 20:31. Stlican Shelf remains the busiest front, five events in two hours, twelve in six, and forty-seven on the day, The Pale House again the pivot. DeadLands has resumed movement after a lull, posting five fresh events and twenty in the past day. Godcrofts continues to burn, with seven events in the latest two hours and thirteen on the day, latest at 21:10. LinnMercy has joined the storm, five events in two hours and nine in twenty-four, leaving the eleven strongpoints split seven Warden to four Colonial as of the cutoff. Stonecradle, after its earlier fury, has gone quiet: no event since 16:40, though the day's count stands at eighteen and casualties remain enormous. Callahan's Passage has seen no fresh strongpoint change since morning, but fighting there stays heavy.
